steps.name: Given User navigate to the Infoez Login page
When User enter email "owner@infoez.com" into email field
And User enter password "Owner@123" into password field
And User clicked on Sign In button
And User clicks on profile icon in Business page
And User select Business dashboard and clicks on add Business
Then User should navigated to Add a business page
And User added Business name "BLUE MOON" in Business name box
And User added Description "All you can eat" in Description box
And User select Category option "Restaurants" from Category drop down
